name: Yakusoku mo Zenbu Anata no Sei
original_name: 約束も全部あなたのせい
source:
A hospital where orphans with incurable diseases are admitted.

One day, Kurokami is told that her best friend Cynthia has died.

In disbelief, the girl investigates the hospital and discovers that it is a human experiment site.

In order to keep her promise, Kurokami decides to escape.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9489]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
收治患有绝症的孤儿的医院。

有一天，黑上被告知她最好的朋友辛西娅去世了。

女孩难以置信地调查了医院，发现这是一个人体实验场。

为了遵守诺言，黑神决定逃跑。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9489]NovelGame[/url]]
